intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis-4 (FHL4) is caused by homozygous mutation in the gene encoding syntaxin-11 (STX11; 605014) on chromosome 6q24.2.

checks.claim: Familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis-4 (FHL4) is caused by homozygous mutation in the STX11 gene, which encodes syntaxin-11.
checks.evidence_quote: we found homozygous mutations in STX11 in five consanguineous Turkish/Kurdish FHL kindreds
checks.explanation: The paper links FHL type 4 to 6q24 and reports homozygous STX11 mutations in affected families.

checks.claim: The STX11 gene is located on chromosome 6q24.2.
checks.evidence_quote: Linkage to a 10 cM region on chromosome 6q24 between D6S1569 and D6S960 defined a novel FHL locus.
checks.explanation: The paper places the locus at 6q24. The band 6q24.2 is the standard, more specific cytogenetic location of the gene, so it counts as restating the paper.

paragraphs.text: Familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (FHL) is a rare autosomal recessive disorder (zur Stadt et al., 2005) that affects young children (Zur Stadt et al., 2006). Müller et al. (2014) noted that the diagnostic criteria include fever, splenomegaly, bicytopenia, hypertriglyceridemia and/or hypofibrinogenemia, and low or absent natural killer (NK) cell activity. FHL4 is the form caused by deficiency of syntaxin-11 (zur Stadt et al., 2005). Syntaxin-11 is involved in cytotoxic lymphocyte exocytosis (Müller et al., 2014).

checks.claim: Familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (FHL) is a rare autosomal recessive disorder.
checks.evidence_quote: Familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (FHL) is a rare autosomal recessive disorder

checks.claim: Familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (FHL) affects young children.
checks.evidence_quote: Familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (FHL) is an autosomal-recessive disease that affects young children.
checks.explanation: The abstract says outright that FHL affects young children.

checks.claim: The diagnostic criteria for FHL include fever.
checks.evidence_quote: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) is a hyperinflammatory disorder clinically diagnosed based on fulfillment of five out of eight criteria including fever, splenomegaly, bicytopenia, hypertriglyceridemia and/or hypofibrinogenemia
checks.explanation: Fever is listed among the diagnostic criteria. The paper gives these as criteria for HLH, of which FHL is a form.

checks.claim: The diagnostic criteria for FHL include splenomegaly.
checks.evidence_quote: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) is a hyperinflammatory disorder clinically diagnosed based on fulfillment of five out of eight criteria including fever, splenomegaly, bicytopenia, hypertriglyceridemia and/or hypofibrinogenemia
checks.explanation: Splenomegaly is listed among the criteria. The paper gives them for HLH in general.

checks.claim: The diagnostic criteria for FHL include bicytopenia.
checks.evidence_quote: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) is a hyperinflammatory disorder clinically diagnosed based on fulfillment of five out of eight criteria including fever, splenomegaly, bicytopenia, hypertriglyceridemia and/or hypofibrinogenemia
checks.explanation: Bicytopenia is listed, but the paper gives these as criteria for HLH, not specifically for FHL.

checks.claim: The diagnostic criteria for FHL include hypertriglyceridemia and/or hypofibrinogenemia.
checks.evidence_quote: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) is a hyperinflammatory disorder clinically diagnosed based on fulfillment of five out of eight criteria including fever, splenomegaly, bicytopenia, hypertriglyceridemia and/or hypofibrinogenemia
checks.explanation: Hypertriglyceridemia and/or hypofibrinogenemia is listed, but the paper gives these as criteria for HLH, not specifically for FHL.

checks.claim: The diagnostic criteria for FHL include low or absent natural killer (NK) cell activity.
checks.evidence_quote: hypertriglyceridemia and/or hypofibrinogenemia, hemophagocytosis, low/absent natural killer (NK) cell activity, hyperferritinemia, and high soluble interleukin (IL)-2 receptor levels
checks.explanation: Low/absent NK cell activity is listed among the criteria. The paper gives them for HLH in general.

checks.claim: FHL4 is the form of FHL caused by deficiency of syntaxin-11.
checks.evidence_quote: We could demonstrate that syntaxin 11 protein was absent in the mononuclear cell fraction of patients with the homozygous 5 bp deletion.
checks.explanation: The paper ties FHL4 to STX11 mutations and shows that the protein is missing in patients.

checks.claim: Syntaxin-11 is involved in cytotoxic lymphocyte exocytosis.
checks.evidence_quote: revealed binding of the N-terminal Habc domain of Stx11 to Munc18-2, stabilizing Stx11 expression, and facilitating cytotoxic lymphocyte exocytosis.

paragraphs.text: In a large consanguineous Kurdish kindred with FHL, zur Stadt et al. (2005) performed genome-wide homozygosity mapping and found linkage to a 10-cM region on chromosome 6q24 between D6S1569 and D6S960, which defined a new FHL locus.

checks.claim: zur Stadt et al. (2005) studied a large consanguineous Kurdish kindred with FHL.
checks.evidence_quote: We performed genome-wide homozygosity mapping in a large consanguineous Kurdish kindred with five children affected with FHL.

checks.claim: zur Stadt et al. (2005) performed genome-wide homozygosity mapping in a large consanguineous Kurdish FHL kindred.
checks.evidence_quote: We performed genome-wide homozygosity mapping in a large consanguineous Kurdish kindred with five children affected with FHL.

checks.claim: In a large consanguineous Kurdish FHL kindred, FHL showed linkage to a 10-cM region on chromosome 6q24 between markers D6S1569 and D6S960.
checks.evidence_quote: Linkage to a 10 cM region on chromosome 6q24 between D6S1569 and D6S960 defined a novel FHL locus.

checks.claim: The 10-cM region on chromosome 6q24 between D6S1569 and D6S960 defined a new FHL locus.
checks.evidence_quote: Linkage to a 10 cM region on chromosome 6q24 between D6S1569 and D6S960 defined a novel FHL locus.

paragraphs.text: Familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis is genetically heterogeneous. zur Stadt et al. (2005) noted that FHL2 and FHL3 are caused by mutations in the perforin gene (PRF1) and in UNC13D, respectively. Müller et al. (2014) noted that FHL5 is associated with mutations in Munc18-2, which is encoded by STXBP2.

checks.claim: Familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis is genetically heterogeneous.
checks.evidence_quote: mutations in the perforin 1 gene (PRF1) and in UNC13D are associated with FHL2 and FHL3, respectively, indicating genetic heterogeneity

checks.claim: FHL2 is caused by mutations in the perforin gene (PRF1).
checks.evidence_quote: mutations in the perforin 1 gene (PRF1) and in UNC13D are associated with FHL2 and FHL3, respectively

checks.claim: FHL3 is caused by mutations in the UNC13D gene.
checks.evidence_quote: mutations in the perforin 1 gene (PRF1) and in UNC13D are associated with FHL2 and FHL3, respectively

checks.claim: FHL5 is associated with mutations in Munc18-2.
checks.evidence_quote: as well as studies of how Munc18-2 mutations associated with FHL5 impact Stx11 binding
checks.explanation: The paper states that Munc18-2 mutations are associated with FHL5.

checks.claim: Munc18-2 is encoded by the STXBP2 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: Mutations in STXBP2 that lead to loss of Munc18-2 expression also cause loss of Stx11 expression in lymphocytes.
checks.explanation: The paper links STXBP2 to Munc18-2 expression.

paragraphs.text: zur Stadt et al. (2005) screened positional candidate genes in the 6q24 region in a large consanguineous Kurdish kindred with FHL. They identified a homozygous 5-bp deletion in the STX11 gene. They found homozygous STX11 mutations in five consanguineous Turkish/Kurdish FHL kindreds. In one family the mutation was a homozygous 19.2-kb genomic deletion spanning the entire coding region of STX11 (exon 2).

checks.claim: zur Stadt et al. (2005) screened positional candidate genes in the 6q24 region in a large consanguineous Kurdish FHL kindred.
checks.evidence_quote: By screening positional candidate genes, we identified a homozygous deletion of 5 bp in the syntaxin 11 gene (STX11) in this family.
checks.explanation: The candidates were positional genes in the linked 6q24 region of the Kurdish kindred.

checks.claim: In a large consanguineous Kurdish FHL kindred, zur Stadt et al. (2005) identified a homozygous 5-bp deletion in the STX11 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: we identified a homozygous deletion of 5 bp in the syntaxin 11 gene (STX11) in this family.

checks.claim: zur Stadt et al. (2005) found homozygous STX11 mutations in five consanguineous Turkish/Kurdish FHL kindreds.
checks.evidence_quote: In addition to this family, we found homozygous mutations in STX11 in five consanguineous Turkish/Kurdish FHL kindreds
checks.explanation: The paper states this directly. Note that these five kindreds are in addition to the index family.

checks.claim: In one FHL family studied by zur Stadt et al. (2005), the STX11 mutation was a homozygous 19.2-kb genomic deletion.
checks.evidence_quote: one family with a large 19.2 kb genomic deletion spanning the entire coding region of STX11 (exon 2)
checks.explanation: The deletion is one of the 'homozygous mutations' described for these kindreds.

checks.claim: The 19.2-kb STX11 genomic deletion found by zur Stadt et al. (2005) spans the entire coding region of STX11 (exon 2).
checks.evidence_quote: one family with a large 19.2 kb genomic deletion spanning the entire coding region of STX11 (exon 2)

paragraphs.text: Rudd et al. (2006) used direct sequencing to screen STX11 in 28 FHL families that did not have perforin mutations. They found STX11 mutations affecting 6 of 34 children in 4 of the 28 unrelated PRF1-negative families. Rudd et al. (2006) noted a milder phenotype in these patients: some had long periods (1 year or more) in remission without specific treatment, which is very uncommon in this disease.

checks.claim: Rudd et al. (2006) used direct sequencing to screen STX11 in 28 FHL families without perforin mutations.
checks.evidence_quote: Mutational analysis of STX11 by direct sequencing was done in 28 FHL families that did not harbour perforin mutations

checks.claim: Rudd et al. (2006) found STX11 mutations affecting 6 of 34 children in 4 of 28 unrelated PRF1-negative FHL families.
checks.evidence_quote: affecting six of 34 children in four of 28 unrelated PRF1 negative families

checks.claim: Rudd et al. (2006) noted a milder phenotype in FHL patients with STX11 mutations.
checks.evidence_quote: Despite the milder phenotype, some children with STX11 mutations developed severe psychomotor retardation.
checks.explanation: The abstract refers to a milder phenotype in the patients with STX11 mutations.

checks.claim: Some FHL patients with STX11 mutations studied by Rudd et al. (2006) had long periods (1 year or more) in remission without specific treatment.
checks.evidence_quote: Three patients experienced long periods (> or = 1 year) in remission without specific treatment, which is very uncommon in this disease.

checks.claim: Long periods of remission without specific treatment are very uncommon in FHL.
checks.evidence_quote: Three patients experienced long periods (> or = 1 year) in remission without specific treatment, which is very uncommon in this disease.

paragraphs.text: Müller et al. (2014) noted that syntaxin-11 deficiency abolishes degranulation by both cytotoxic T cells and NK cells.

checks.claim: Syntaxin-11 deficiency abolishes degranulation by cytotoxic T cells.
checks.evidence_quote: Although syntaxin-11 (Stx11)-deficiency abrogates degranulation by both cytotoxic T cells and NK cells.

checks.claim: Syntaxin-11 deficiency abolishes degranulation by NK cells.
checks.evidence_quote: Although syntaxin-11 (Stx11)-deficiency abrogates degranulation by both cytotoxic T cells and NK cells.

paragraphs.text: Müller et al. (2014) noted that Stx11-deficient mice, like patients with STX11 nonsense mutations, typically have less severe disease than other FHL subtypes.

checks.claim: Stx11-deficient mice typically have less severe disease than other FHL subtypes.
checks.evidence_quote: Relative to other FHL subtypes, patients with STX11 non-sense mutations or Stx11-deficient mice typically display less severe disease.

checks.claim: Patients with STX11 nonsense mutations typically have less severe disease than other FHL subtypes.
checks.evidence_quote: Relative to other FHL subtypes, patients with STX11 non-sense mutations or Stx11-deficient mice typically display less severe disease.
